Third-party services

Third-party services

Last updated: October 4, 2026

Versa Player may interact with external services only when the corresponding feature is enabled or used by the user.

Google Play

App distribution, Versa Premium purchases, restoration and entitlement status.

Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

Native advertising for free-edition users when applicable configuration and consent allow it.

Google User Messaging Platform (UMP)

Presentation and management of advertising privacy and consent choices where applicable.

Internet radio

Versa Player may query a station directory and connect to the server of the station selected by the user. Stations and their content are independent from Versa Player.

Device voice services

Speech recognition and synthesis may depend on the service configured in Android and on that provider's own policies.

Lyrics and artwork

No commercial remote lyrics or artwork provider is enabled by default. Versa Player uses embedded/local content and lets users manually add lyrics or artwork or open a user-initiated web search.

Listing a service here does not imply ownership, affiliation or sponsorship unless expressly stated.
